liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Jerry's vocal sounds plaintive and earnest; his last pre-jam break moves to chords, rousing the crowd; Reviewer calls the Scarlet>Fire pairing excellent [8][13][14]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (2 reviews): The track labeled Fire opens with a long continuation of the Scarlet jam, which began with crowd clapping; Reviewer recalls Jerry's playing and Fire on the Mountain as the night's high point, converting him into a fan [8][10]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Considerable bite in this version, thanks to Garcia [9]
- **Big River** (1 review): Crowd is delighted; reviewer finds the performance only slightly above average [9]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version exceptional, though the recording's sound is not so good [11]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Estimated>Eyes as excellent [13]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer is enjoying the Wharf Rat in this set [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton.miller.fix.97354.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton-miller.82238.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd79-02-10.aud.glyde.13849.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Balanced mix of audience and band in this audience recording; Sound is still remote but slightly brighter and cleaner than the reviewer's previous listen; Known flaws: static throughout, described as mild [4][8][9]
- **gd1979-02-10.set2.sbd.miller.97352.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 117 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: The upgraded second set sounds noticeably better than earlier versions [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton.miller.fix.97354.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [1]. Also: Source is Sony ECM 250 and cassette-based, with pitch correction; the opening Don't Ease Me In comes from a Nakamichi 300 cassette; Tapes were provided by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [1]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton-miller.82238.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [2]. Also: Opening Don't Ease Me In (to 1:19) comes from a three-Nakamichi 300 cassette source; tapes from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [2]
- **gd79-02-10.aud.glyde.13849.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Glyde; source: Audience Recording [4]. Also: Transferred with EAC in secure mode, pops fixed in SoundForge 5, Scarlet and Fire split with CDWav, converted to seekable shn [4]
- **gd1979-02-10.set2.sbd.miller.97352.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [5]. Also: Second set recorded front-of-board with a Sony ECM 250 to cassette master, then digitized via Samplitude and Adobe Audition; Patch source supplies parts of Eyes, Sugar Magnolia, One More Saturday Night and I Need A Miracle; Rob Eaton lent a DAT deck [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster - Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hall](https://www.dead.net/archives/1979/artwork/poster-soldiers-sailors-memorial-hall) [20]
- Poster by David Franklin_Perkins Grateful Dead: [1979-02-09 Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall, Kansas City, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-02-09-soldiers-and-sailors-memorial-hall-kansas-city-ks-usa/) [21]
- Poster by David Franklin_Perkins Grateful Dead: [1979-02-09 Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall, Kansas City, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-02-09-soldiers-and-sailors-memorial-hall-kansas-city-ks-usa/) [22]
